mukta-m0-p103-v2551.quick_english: I worship the goddess Kalyāṇī, the mother of auspiciousness.

mukta-m0-p103-v2552.quick_english: I worship Lakṣmī Rohiṇī, who possesses infinite power.

mukta-m0-p103-v2553.quick_english: I worship Kālikā, who grants desires and is generous in compassion.

mukta-m0-p103-v2554.quick_english: I always worship the goddess Caṇḍikā, who has fierce valor.

mukta-m0-p103-v2555.quick_english: I worship Śāmbhavī Lakṣmī, who is the soul of all beings.

mukta-m0-p103-v2556.quick_english: I always worship Durgā with devotion, the destroyer of difficulty and distress.

mukta-m0-p103-v2557.quick_english: I worship the goddess Subhadrā, the mother of Subhadrā.

mukta-m0-p103-v2558.quick_english: O Mother, following you removes sorrow.

mukta-m0-p103-v2559.quick_english: A bad son may sometimes be born, but a bad mother never exists.

mukta-m0-p103-v2560.quick_english: A bad son may sometimes be born, but a bad mother never exists.

mukta-m0-p103-v2561.quick_english: A bad son may sometimes be born, but a bad mother never exists.

mukta-m0-p103-v2562.quick_english: Supportless, O mother of Lambodara, where shall I go for refuge?

mukta-m0-p103-v2563.quick_english: O Mother, who knows what is to be chanted in the proper method of chanting?

mukta-m0-p103-v2564.quick_english: This is the fruit of your taking my hand, O Mother.

mukta-m0-p103-v2565.quick_english: For one who chants, 'Mṛdānī, Rudrāṇī, Śiva, Śiva, Bhavānī'...

mukta-m0-p103-v2566.quick_english: O Mother, you indeed bestow fitting and supreme compassion.

mukta-m0-p103-v2567.quick_english: Indeed, a mother does not disregard a son even when he is covered by a series of offenses.

mukta-m0-p103-v2568.quick_english: Knowing this, O great goddess, do as is fitting.

mukta-m0-p103-v2569.quick_english: By whose mere grace Durgā may always be pleased.

mukta-m0-p103-v2570.quick_english: Noble Durgā, victorious, primordial, three-eyed, holder of the trident.

mukta-m0-p103-v2571.quick_english: She is mind, intellect, and ego, the form of consciousness, the pyre, and consciousness itself.

mukta-m0-p103-v2572.quick_english: Endless, becoming, to be realized, existence, auspicious, and the eternal course.

mukta-m0-p103-v2573.quick_english: She is all knowledge, the daughter of Dakṣa, and the destroyer of Dakṣa's sacrifice.

mukta-m0-p103-v2574.quick_english: She is clad in silk garments and delights with the soft sound of her anklets.

mukta-m0-p103-v2575.quick_english: Also named are the nine Durgās and Mātaṅgī, who is worshipped by the sage Mataṅga.

mukta-m0-p143-v3551.quick_english: He is the maker of all, all-faced, hard to conquer, conqueror of burdens, and victory itself.

mukta-m0-p143-v3552.quick_english: He is the lord of yoga, situated in the savior, the supreme person, and elephant-eared.

mukta-m0-p143-v3553.quick_english: He has the splendor of Śambhu, a body that is sacrifice, is the soul of all, and is magnified by the Sāman chants.

mukta-m0-p143-v3554.quick_english: He is deep-naveled, large-bellied, full-chested, and large-armed.

mukta-m0-p143-v3555.quick_english: He is complete in all limbs and marked by all auspicious characteristics.

mukta-m0-p143-v3556.quick_english: He holds a rosary, displays the gesture of knowledge, and bestows victory.

mukta-m0-p143-v3557.quick_english: He is of unfailing accomplishment, the support, and yet free from the distinction of support and supported.

mukta-m0-p143-v3558.quick_english: He is the witness of actions, the doer of actions, and the giver of the fruits of action and non-action.

mukta-m0-p143-v3559.quick_english: He has a body of compassion, is tawny, and is revealed by the secret teachings.

mukta-m0-p143-v3560.quick_english: He is full bliss, supreme bliss, the giver of wealth, and the supporter of the earth.

mukta-m0-p143-v3561.quick_english: He is auspicious, the abode of beings, and indeed the giver of enjoyments, great-minded.

mukta-m0-p143-v3562.quick_english: He is the maker of all, all-eyed, the oblation itself, and the eater of offerings to gods and ancestors.

mukta-m0-p143-v3563.quick_english: He is the giver of fame, the remover of sorrow, and the giver of the fruits of the three aims of life.

mukta-m0-p143-v3564.quick_english: He is the thousand-headed supreme person, thousand-eyed and thousand-footed.

mukta-m0-p143-v3565.quick_english: He is the lord of the field, the bearer of patience, abiding in dissolution, and fond of sweet balls.

mukta-m0-p143-v3566.quick_english: He is the blessed lord, easily attained by devotees, a sacrificer, and fond of sacrificers.

mukta-m0-p143-v3567.quick_english: This set of one hundred and eight names has been proclaimed as the very essence.

mukta-m0-p143-v3568.quick_english: One should recite this hymn with devotion; then the king of the gaṇas is pleased.

mukta-m0-p143-v3569.quick_english: O you who are intent on grace to the world, tell that to me for Śiva's sake.

mukta-m0-p143-v3570.quick_english: Indeed, from not worshipping Gaṇeśa, a state afflicted by obstacles arose.

mukta-m0-p143-v3571.quick_english: Having worshipped the great Gaṇapati with devotion according to rule...

mukta-m0-p143-v3572.quick_english: Satisfied by the worship of Śambhu, the great Gaṇapati himself was pleased.

mukta-m0-p143-v3573.quick_english: Then, pleased, he spoke to him this thousand of his own names.

mukta-m0-p143-v3574.quick_english: He is single-tusked, curved-trunked, elephant-faced, and large-bellied.

mukta-m0-p143-v3575.quick_english: He is beautiful-faced, fierce-faced, wise, the king of obstacles, and elephant-faced.

mukta-m0-p157-v3901.quick_english: He is the seizer, Vishnu, Shiva, the wind, the season, and radiant like the fire that ends the world.

mukta-m0-p157-v3902.quick_english: He is great Indra, whose hymns are praised, the cause of praise, and the maker of light.

mukta-m0-p157-v3903.quick_english: He removes disease, gives happiness, is happiness itself, auspicious, and the best among the capable.

mukta-m0-p157-v3904.quick_english: He is golden-seeded, health itself, wise, a kinsman, awakened, and great.

mukta-m0-p157-v3905.quick_english: He is dear to all, endures all, and repels all enemies.

mukta-m0-p157-v3906.quick_english: He shines with armlet ornaments, is illuminated, and is a blazing, shining fire.

mukta-m0-p157-v3907.quick_english: He is the light of all, the light of existence, the maker of all splendor, and spotless.

mukta-m0-p157-v3908.quick_english: He does good, has a wish-fulfilling form, and is the receptacle of all auspiciousness.

mukta-m0-p157-v3909.quick_english: He is of noble deeds, of good conduct, of great splendor, and blazing with vigor.

mukta-m0-p157-v3910.quick_english: He is radiant, of good fame, the overseer of classes, and fond of offerings.

mukta-m0-p157-v3911.quick_english: He moves through the sky, is swift-moving, quick-going, possessed of sacred knowledge, and a sky-mover.

mukta-m0-p157-v3912.quick_english: He is the progenitor, creator of beings, the living principle, a lamp, and the illuminator of all.

mukta-m0-p157-v3913.quick_english: He slays demons, removes obstacles, wears a crown, and is dear to the good-minded.

mukta-m0-p157-v3914.quick_english: He is of disciplined conduct, of auspicious conduct, and devoted to his own proper conduct.

mukta-m0-p157-v3915.quick_english: He is distinguished by himself, of distinguished self, to be established, and adorned with knowledge.

mukta-m0-p157-v3916.quick_english: He is the self sung by all the Vedas, the abode of all the Vedas, and dissolution itself.

mukta-m0-p157-v3917.quick_english: He is endowed with action, exceedingly radiant, most excellent, and a giver of boons.

mukta-m0-p157-v3918.quick_english: He is an imperishable ornament, possesses divine knowledge, and has a known intent.

mukta-m0-p157-v3919.quick_english: He holds the discus, bears the thunderbolt, is the lord of gods, and is kind to the world.

mukta-m0-p157-v3920.quick_english: He removes darkness, is most excellent, revolves the ages, and creates the beginning of the ages.

mukta-m0-p157-v3921.quick_english: He gives auspiciousness, is auspicious, is splendor, performs auspicious deeds, and is the abode of auspiciousness.

mukta-m0-p157-v3922.quick_english: He bears strength, gives strength, is a kinsman, strong, and the best among the strong.

mukta-m0-p157-v3923.quick_english: He is the leader of the year and sacrifice, and the one who sets the wheel of time in motion.

mukta-m0-p157-v3924.quick_english: He is of beautiful form, good-minded Soma, Govinda, and born at the beginning of the world.

mukta-m0-p157-v3925.quick_english: He is beyond Indra, of manifold form, Skanda, the conqueror of enemy cities.

mukta-m0-p166-v4126.quick_english: He is the root nature and bliss, the knower of wisdom, and the deluder of the universe.

mukta-m0-p166-v4127.quick_english: He is desired by all, of infinite nature, and the one who subdues and benefits all beings.

mukta-m0-p166-v4128.quick_english: He is without conditions, beloved, the swan, perishable, and the controller of all.

mukta-m0-p166-v4129.quick_english: He is the knower of the field, the lord of nature, the spirit, and the holder of the universe's thread.

mukta-m0-p166-v4130.quick_english: He is sought through yoga, lotus-naveled, reclining on Śeṣa, and the lord of Śrī.

mukta-m0-p166-v4131.quick_english: He bears Śrī eternally on his chest, is the treasure of Śrī, the bearer of Śrī, and Hari.

mukta-m0-p166-v4132.quick_english: His chest is illuminated by the Kaustubha gem; he is Mādhava, the destroyer of the world's distress.

mukta-m0-p166-v4133.quick_english: Clad in yellow, he is the lord of the world, the sustainer of the world, and the father of the world.

mukta-m0-p166-v4134.quick_english: His heroism alone shines forth in the world; he does not speak from ego, and he is made of the world.

mukta-m0-p166-v4135.quick_english: All his efforts are unfailing, and his consciousness surpasses that of Brahmā, Rudra, and others.

mukta-m0-p166-v4136.quick_english: He is dear to all gods, the very activity of all gods, and unsurpassed.

mukta-m0-p166-v4137.quick_english: He is the enjoyer of sacrifice, the giver of its fruits, the lord of sacrifice, and the inspirer of sacrifice.

mukta-m0-p166-v4138.quick_english: He alone gives honor to the twice-born, is fierce, the family deity, and the destroyer of demons.

mukta-m0-p166-v4139.quick_english: He is the sole womb of all worlds and the sole sphere of all worlds.

mukta-m0-p166-v4140.quick_english: He bears the conch, holds the Nandaka sword and a lotus in his hands, and has Garuḍa as his vehicle.

mukta-m0-p166-v4141.quick_english: He is of infinite fame, lord without fortune, manly, and entirely auspicious.

mukta-m0-p166-v4142.quick_english: He is the creator of worlds of crores of Brahmās and possesses the great strength of crores of winds.

mukta-m0-p166-v4143.quick_english: He possesses the wealth of crores of Kuberas and is the destroyer of crores of enemies.

mukta-m0-p166-v4144.quick_english: He is as profound as crores of oceans and is named like crores of holy places.

mukta-m0-p166-v4145.quick_english: He destroys sins as if through crores of horse sacrifices, and worship of him equals crores of sacrifices.

mukta-m0-p166-v4146.quick_english: He is the form of crores of knowledges of Brahman, pervading the rays, and of pure fame.

mukta-m0-p166-v4147.quick_english: He is the primeval god, conqueror of the world, Mukunda the giver of liberation, and the slayer of Kālanemi.

mukta-m0-p166-v4148.quick_english: He is eternally content, of true nature among humans, fearless, and the destroyer of hell.

mukta-m0-p166-v4149.quick_english: He brings forbearance to the world, is eternal, compassionate, and the refuge of good people.

mukta-m0-p166-v4150.quick_english: He is beyond the senses, the seed of the universe, and the lord of Prajāpati's meditation.

mukta-m0-p167-v4151.quick_english: He has the sun and moon as eyes, is the eater of the universe, and has gone beyond all.

mukta-m0-p167-v4152.quick_english: He is the lord of all worlds, free from possessiveness, unattached, and endowed with wondrous enjoyment.

mukta-m0-p167-v4153.quick_english: He is all, the lord of the goddess Śrī, and adorned with every ornament.

mukta-m0-p167-v4154.quick_english: He is all-knowing among all the gods and the leader of all deities.

mukta-m0-p167-v4155.quick_english: He is the armor of all the gods and the crest jewel of all the gods.

mukta-m0-p167-v4156.quick_english: He is all-pervading, the benefactor of all, and also the sun; he has slain his enemies and grants excellent delight.

mukta-m0-p167-v4157.quick_english: He is endowed with Brahmā and Śambhu as his halves, elder to Brahmā, yet a child, and self-ruling.

mukta-m0-p167-v4158.quick_english: He accomplishes all purposes, knows what is to be done, and has always abandoned action for his own sake.

mukta-m0-p167-v4159.quick_english: He is always unpleasant, always satisfied, always nourished, and always worshipped.

mukta-m0-p167-v4160.quick_english: He has a thousand names, belongs to three ages, has four forms, and four arms.

mukta-m0-p167-v4161.quick_english: He is Nārāyaṇa, with hair like muñja grass, and emerged beyond all yoga.

mukta-m0-p167-v4162.quick_english: He is the best among the Sādhyas, an ancient seer, devoted to steadfastness and peace.

mukta-m0-p167-v4163.quick_english: He is Nara and Kṛṣṇa, Hari, the son of Dharma, and one who lives by dharma.

mukta-m0-p167-v4164.quick_english: He is beyond time, conqueror of Kandarpa, and the lord of sages seen by Urvaśī.

mukta-m0-p167-v4165.quick_english: He consists of all gods, is the teacher of Brahmā, and the lord of the goddess of speech.

mukta-m0-p167-v4166.quick_english: He is worthy of honor from all, destroyer of the world's dullness, and the slayer of Madhu.

mukta-m0-p167-v4167.quick_english: He is the primeval knower, maker of the Veda, the very self of the Veda, and an ocean of scripture.

mukta-m0-p167-v4168.quick_english: He is the king of knowledge, king of wisdom, an ocean of wisdom, and of unbroken intellect.

mukta-m0-p167-v4169.quick_english: He pervades the wind and ocean in play and is the promulgator of the four Vedas.

mukta-m0-p167-v4170.quick_english: He made the host of gods immortal and is the cause of the origin of nectar.

mukta-m0-p167-v4171.quick_english: He is the slayer of Hiraṇyākṣa, lord of the earth, and ordainer of śrāddha and other rites.

mukta-m0-p167-v4172.quick_english: He is the excellent sole enjoyer of oblations and libations, and the sole giver of excellent virtues.

mukta-m0-p167-v4173.quick_english: He is the great boar, destroyer of those who harm sacrifice, and the refuge of sacrificers.

mukta-m0-p167-v4174.quick_english: He is the one hero of wondrous strength and the sole breaker of yantras and mantras.

mukta-m0-p167-v4175.quick_english: He has nails harder than millions of thunderbolts and bears a form as difficult to behold as a mighty elephant.

mukta-m0-p169-v4201.quick_english: Bhīṣma is a treasury of all Śiva’s knowledge, a great teacher, and one whose deity is fire.

mukta-m0-p169-v4202.quick_english: He is a form of unmatched darkness, whose sole offering is lifelong celibacy.

mukta-m0-p169-v4203.quick_english: He is the primordial king, father of the earth, who makes it yield all jewels.

mukta-m0-p169-v4204.quick_english: He gives sustenance to the world, is the best of emperors, and bears terrible weapons.

mukta-m0-p169-v4205.quick_english: He is the doer, expounder, and promoter of the duties of the classes and stages of life.

mukta-m0-p169-v4206.quick_english: He embodies the heroic duty of the Kakutstha line and bears the burden of royal duty.

mukta-m0-p169-v4207.quick_english: He is the nine jewels, a treasury of gems, the overseer of all, and a great treasure.

mukta-m0-p169-v4208.quick_english: The world-subduing son of Daśaratha is the king, the refuge of all jewels.

mukta-m0-p169-v4209.quick_english: He sees the far shore of knowledge and insight beyond Indra, and he is an ocean of forbearance.

mukta-m0-p169-v4210.quick_english: At his father's command he gave up sovereignty, yet remained fearless of any rival's rise.

mukta-m0-p169-v4211.quick_english: He is the lord of the world who gained the jewel-mountain Citrakūṭa and moves in battle.

mukta-m0-p169-v4212.quick_english: His arrow is revered by Brahmā, Indra, and others; he is the slayer of Mārīca and Virādha.

mukta-m0-p169-v4213.quick_english: He bore a single arrow that slew the fourteen thousand demons.

mukta-m0-p169-v4214.quick_english: He gave Jaṭāyu the path through fire and granted heaven to Kabandha.

mukta-m0-p169-v4215.quick_english: He is the one who, by piercing seven palm trees, drew down the banner of the demon of the netherworld.

mukta-m0-p169-v4216.quick_english: He is the lord of Hanūmat, chief among the Rudras, and the sustainer of all the monkey bodies.

mukta-m0-p169-v4217.quick_english: With a single arrow he dried and burned the ocean, along with countless barbarians.

mukta-m0-p169-v4218.quick_english: He is a treasure of fame for building a wondrous, unprecedented bridge across the ocean.

mukta-m0-p169-v4219.quick_english: He cut down the Paulastya lineage in Janasthāna, made arrogant by boons.

mukta-m0-p169-v4220.quick_english: He cut off Rāvaṇa's head and gave Indra fearless, sole sovereignty.

mukta-m0-p169-v4221.quick_english: He removes the godhood of demons, is a mansion of dharma, and is praised by many.

mukta-m0-p169-v4222.quick_english: He alone revived his entire dead army by creating nectar.

mukta-m0-p169-v4223.quick_english: He is revered by Brahmā, Sūrya, Indra, Rudra, and others, worshipped, and dear to the good.

mukta-m0-p169-v4224.quick_english: Endowed with a lord's unequaled compassion, he is dear to the good, whether low or high.

mukta-m0-p169-v4225.quick_english: Acting as yours in the fitting guise of a hunter, he brings satisfaction to all.

mukta-m0-p170-v4226.quick_english: Directly manifest, skilled, led by noble Indra and Agni, he is unconquered.

mukta-m0-p170-v4227.quick_english: He is the delighter of Yaśodā, joyful, and the rising one over the circle of the earth.

mukta-m0-p170-v4228.quick_english: Having attained the world of Brahma, he is the protector of caṇḍālas and all other beings.

mukta-m0-p170-v4229.quick_english: He is Rāma's companion, Lakṣmaṇa son of Sumitrā, the slayer of Indrajit.

mukta-m0-p170-v4230.quick_english: He is Bharata, slayer of millions of formidable gandharvas, and destroyer of Lavaṇa.

mukta-m0-p170-v4231.quick_english: He is the source of the eternal and non-eternal, Dhanvantari, sacrifice, and the supporter of the world.

mukta-m0-p170-v4232.quick_english: He is the one with severed head, afflicted for the sake of instruction, who made friendship with a son.

mukta-m0-p170-v4233.quick_english: Yoga-natured, upon the breaking of meditation, he reduced the sons of Sagara to ashes.

mukta-m0-p170-v4234.quick_english: He is Śambhu, burner of the three cities, who uplifted the chariot on which the universe was steadied.

mukta-m0-p170-v4235.quick_english: He is the fire named by the Vājapeya and other rites, devoted to the duties of the Veda.

mukta-m0-p170-v4236.quick_english: He is the yoga of meditation that illuminates the universe and removes the darkness of delusion.

mukta-m0-p170-v4237.quick_english: At the great dissolution he is the one, without a second, the king of all demons.

mukta-m0-p170-v4238.quick_english: He is the one by whose serpent-hood form the earth is placed upon the waters.

mukta-m0-p170-v4239.quick_english: Clad in blue, lord of Vāruṇī, he removes the faults of mind, speech, and body.

mukta-m0-p170-v4240.quick_english: He is the restrainer of Bali, terrible, the son of Rohiṇī, the slayer of Pralamba.

mukta-m0-p170-v4241.quick_english: He is the lover of Revatī, indeed of ancient devotion, the elder brother of Acyuta.

mukta-m0-p170-v4242.quick_english: He is a descendant of Vṛṣṇi, best of the Sātvatas, descendant of Śūra, and upholder of the Yadu family.

mukta-m0-p170-v4243.quick_english: His childhood, desired by Brahmā and others, is an eternal festival for the world.

mukta-m0-p170-v4244.quick_english: He is the enemy of the demon Vatsa, slayer of Keśin, enemy of Dhenuka, and lord of cows.

mukta-m0-p170-v4245.quick_english: He is the subduer of Kāliya, beloved by all the cowherds and cowherdesses.

mukta-m0-p170-v4246.quick_english: He is the crusher of Ariṣṭa and the giver of liberation to the cowherdesses maddened by love.

mukta-m0-p170-v4247.quick_english: He is the enemy of Kaṃsa, who established Ugrasena and others in the kingdom, destroyer of enemies, immortal.

mukta-m0-p170-v4248.quick_english: He abandoned his devotee Jarāsandha and gave fame to Bhīmasena.

mukta-m0-p170-v4249.quick_english: He is the lover of Rukmiṇī, the chastiser of Rukmin, and the destroyer of Naraka.

mukta-m0-p170-v4250.quick_english: Beloved of all beautiful women, enemy of the demons, he is the one whose banner bears Garuḍa.

mukta-m0-p172-v4276.quick_english: The lord of stars, radiant like the sun, is the best; Venus is the lord of poets.

mukta-m0-p172-v4277.quick_english: Wind and pure fire are the best; Shankara is the king of the Rudras and the teacher.

mukta-m0-p172-v4278.quick_english: The first of letters is foremost, Gauri is the foremost woman, Shri is the foremost power, and Narada is foremost.

mukta-m0-p172-v4279.quick_english: Pavana is the lord of the winds, and Varuna is the lord of aquatic creatures.

mukta-m0-p172-v4280.quick_english: Food is foremost; the Sudarshana is the foremost weapon, and the thunderbolt is the best striking weapon.

mukta-m0-p172-v4281.quick_english: Arundhati is foremost, the lord devoted to one wife is supreme, and indeed the sacred fig tree is the king of all trees.

mukta-m0-p172-v4282.quick_english: Meru is the lord of mountains, the path is foremost, the Sama is the foremost chant, and it is the best of times.

mukta-m0-p82-v2047.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p82-v2047.question: What comprehensive accomplishment follows from reciting the text three times?
premises: The text is recited three times.
The goddess is addressed.
Everything succeeds in every way.
mukta-m0-p82-v2047.inference: Reciting the text three times brings complete accomplishment of all aims.

mukta-m0-p82-v2048.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p82-v2048.question: How does the recitation fulfill both spiritual and material desires?
premises: A seeker of liberation obtains liberation.
A seeker of wealth obtains wealth.
Both results are stated as outcomes.
mukta-m0-p82-v2048.inference: The recitation grants the specific goal sought, whether liberation or wealth.

mukta-m0-p82-v2049.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p82-v2049.question: What long-term benefits arise by the end of a year of practice?
premises: Greatness is attained.
The time frame is the end of a year.
Destruction of enemies arises.
mukta-m0-p82-v2049.inference: By the end of a year, the practice yields greatness and the destruction of enemies.
uncertainties: The exact form and meaning of mahitva/ are uncertain due to the trailing slash.

mukta-m0-p82-v2050.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p82-v2050.question: What benefit results from constant recitation performed with devotion?
premises: A person may recite this text always.
The recitation is performed with devotion.
Welfare arises as the outcome of such recitation.
mukta-m0-p82-v2050.inference: Constant devotional recitation produces welfare for the reciter.

mukta-m0-p103-v2551.plain_english: I worship the goddess Kalyāṇī, the mother of auspiciousness.

mukta-m0-p103-v2552.plain_english: I worship Lakṣmī Rohiṇī, who possesses infinite power.

mukta-m0-p103-v2553.plain_english: I worship Kālikā, who grants desires and is generous in compassion.

mukta-m0-p103-v2554.plain_english: I always worship the goddess Caṇḍikā, who has fierce valor.

mukta-m0-p103-v2555.plain_english: I worship Śāmbhavī Lakṣmī, who is the soul of all beings.

mukta-m0-p103-v2556.plain_english: I always worship Durgā with devotion, the destroyer of difficulty and distress.

mukta-m0-p103-v2557.plain_english: I worship the goddess Subhadrā, the mother of Subhadrā.

mukta-m0-p103-v2558.plain_english: O Mother, following you removes sorrow.

mukta-m0-p103-v2559.plain_english: A bad son may sometimes be born, but a bad mother never exists.
mukta-m0-p103-v2559.sanskrit_cite: kuputro jāyeta kvacidapi kumātā na bhavati

mukta-m0-p103-v2560.plain_english: A bad son may sometimes be born, but a bad mother never exists.
mukta-m0-p103-v2560.sanskrit_cite: kuputro jāyeta kvacidapi kumātā na bhavati

mukta-m0-p103-v2561.plain_english: A bad son may sometimes be born, but a bad mother never exists.
mukta-m0-p103-v2561.sanskrit_cite: kuputro jāyeta kvacidapi kumātā na bhavati

mukta-m0-p103-v2562.plain_english: Supportless, O mother of Lambodara, where shall I go for refuge?

mukta-m0-p103-v2563.plain_english: O Mother, who knows what is to be chanted in the proper method of chanting?

mukta-m0-p103-v2564.plain_english: This is the fruit of your taking my hand, O Mother.

mukta-m0-p103-v2565.plain_english: For one who chants, 'Mṛdānī, Rudrāṇī, Śiva, Śiva, Bhavānī'...

mukta-m0-p103-v2566.plain_english: O Mother, you indeed bestow fitting and supreme compassion.

mukta-m0-p103-v2567.plain_english: Indeed, a mother does not disregard a son even when he is covered by a series of offenses.

mukta-m0-p103-v2568.plain_english: Knowing this, O great goddess, do as is fitting.
mukta-m0-p103-v2568.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ jñātvā mahādevi yathā yogyantathā kuru

mukta-m0-p103-v2569.plain_english: By whose mere grace Durgā may always be pleased.
mukta-m0-p103-v2569.sanskrit_cite: yasya prasādamātreṇa durgā prītā sadā bhavet

mukta-m0-p103-v2570.plain_english: Noble Durgā, victorious, primordial, three-eyed, holder of the trident.
mukta-m0-p103-v2570.sanskrit_cite: āryā durgā jayā ādyā trinetrā śūladhāriṇī

mukta-m0-p103-v2571.plain_english: She is mind, intellect, and ego, the form of consciousness, the pyre, and consciousness itself.

mukta-m0-p103-v2572.plain_english: Endless, becoming, to be realized, existence, auspicious, and the eternal course.
mukta-m0-p103-v2572.sanskrit_cite: anantā bhāvinī bhāvyā bhavā bhavyā sadāgatiḥ

mukta-m0-p103-v2573.plain_english: She is all knowledge, the daughter of Dakṣa, and the destroyer of Dakṣa's sacrifice.

mukta-m0-p103-v2574.plain_english: She is clad in silk garments and delights with the soft sound of her anklets.

mukta-m0-p103-v2575.plain_english: Also named are the nine Durgās and Mātaṅgī, who is worshipped by the sage Mataṅga.

mukta-m0-p143-v3551.plain_english: He is the maker of all, all-faced, hard to conquer, conqueror of burdens, and victory itself.

mukta-m0-p143-v3552.plain_english: He is the lord of yoga, situated in the savior, the supreme person, and elephant-eared.

mukta-m0-p143-v3553.plain_english: He has the splendor of Śambhu, a body that is sacrifice, is the soul of all, and is magnified by the Sāman chants.

mukta-m0-p143-v3554.plain_english: He is deep-naveled, large-bellied, full-chested, and large-armed.

mukta-m0-p143-v3555.plain_english: He is complete in all limbs and marked by all auspicious characteristics.

mukta-m0-p143-v3556.plain_english: He holds a rosary, displays the gesture of knowledge, and bestows victory.

mukta-m0-p143-v3557.plain_english: He is of unfailing accomplishment, the support, and yet free from the distinction of support and supported.

mukta-m0-p143-v3558.plain_english: He is the witness of actions, the doer of actions, and the giver of the fruits of action and non-action.

mukta-m0-p143-v3559.plain_english: He has a body of compassion, is tawny, and is revealed by the secret teachings.

mukta-m0-p143-v3560.plain_english: He is full bliss, supreme bliss, the giver of wealth, and the supporter of the earth.

mukta-m0-p143-v3561.plain_english: He is auspicious, the abode of beings, and indeed the giver of enjoyments, great-minded.

mukta-m0-p143-v3562.plain_english: He is the maker of all, all-eyed, the oblation itself, and the eater of offerings to gods and ancestors.

mukta-m0-p143-v3563.plain_english: He is the giver of fame, the remover of sorrow, and the giver of the fruits of the three aims of life.

mukta-m0-p143-v3564.plain_english: He is the thousand-headed supreme person, thousand-eyed and thousand-footed.

mukta-m0-p143-v3565.plain_english: He is the lord of the field, the bearer of patience, abiding in dissolution, and fond of sweet balls.

mukta-m0-p143-v3566.plain_english: He is the blessed lord, easily attained by devotees, a sacrificer, and fond of sacrificers.

mukta-m0-p143-v3567.plain_english: This set of one hundred and eight names has been proclaimed as the very essence.

mukta-m0-p143-v3568.plain_english: One should recite this hymn with devotion; then the king of the gaṇas is pleased.

mukta-m0-p143-v3569.plain_english: O you who are intent on grace to the world, tell that to me for Śiva's sake.

mukta-m0-p143-v3570.plain_english: Indeed, from not worshipping Gaṇeśa, a state afflicted by obstacles arose.

mukta-m0-p143-v3571.plain_english: Having worshipped the great Gaṇapati with devotion according to rule...

mukta-m0-p143-v3572.plain_english: Satisfied by the worship of Śambhu, the great Gaṇapati himself was pleased.

mukta-m0-p143-v3573.plain_english: Then, pleased, he spoke to him this thousand of his own names.

mukta-m0-p143-v3574.plain_english: He is single-tusked, curved-trunked, elephant-faced, and large-bellied.

mukta-m0-p143-v3575.plain_english: He is beautiful-faced, fierce-faced, wise, the king of obstacles, and elephant-faced.

mukta-m0-p157-v3901.plain_english: He is the seizer, Vishnu, Shiva, the wind, the season, and radiant like the fire that ends the world.

mukta-m0-p157-v3902.plain_english: He is great Indra, whose hymns are praised, the cause of praise, and the maker of light.

mukta-m0-p157-v3903.plain_english: He removes disease, gives happiness, is happiness itself, auspicious, and the best among the capable.

mukta-m0-p157-v3904.plain_english: He is golden-seeded, health itself, wise, a kinsman, awakened, and great.

mukta-m0-p157-v3905.plain_english: He is dear to all, endures all, and repels all enemies.

mukta-m0-p157-v3906.plain_english: He shines with armlet ornaments, is illuminated, and is a blazing, shining fire.

mukta-m0-p157-v3907.plain_english: He is the light of all, the light of existence, the maker of all splendor, and spotless.

mukta-m0-p157-v3908.plain_english: He does good, has a wish-fulfilling form, and is the receptacle of all auspiciousness.

mukta-m0-p157-v3909.plain_english: He is of noble deeds, of good conduct, of great splendor, and blazing with vigor.

mukta-m0-p157-v3910.plain_english: He is radiant, of good fame, the overseer of classes, and fond of offerings.

mukta-m0-p157-v3911.plain_english: He moves through the sky, is swift-moving, quick-going, possessed of sacred knowledge, and a sky-mover.

mukta-m0-p157-v3912.plain_english: He is the progenitor, creator of beings, the living principle, a lamp, and the illuminator of all.

mukta-m0-p157-v3913.plain_english: He slays demons, removes obstacles, wears a crown, and is dear to the good-minded.

mukta-m0-p157-v3914.plain_english: He is of disciplined conduct, of auspicious conduct, and devoted to his own proper conduct.

mukta-m0-p157-v3915.plain_english: He is distinguished by himself, of distinguished self, to be established, and adorned with knowledge.

mukta-m0-p157-v3916.plain_english: He is the self sung by all the Vedas, the abode of all the Vedas, and dissolution itself.

mukta-m0-p157-v3917.plain_english: He is endowed with action, exceedingly radiant, most excellent, and a giver of boons.

mukta-m0-p157-v3918.plain_english: He is an imperishable ornament, possesses divine knowledge, and has a known intent.

mukta-m0-p157-v3919.plain_english: He holds the discus, bears the thunderbolt, is the lord of gods, and is kind to the world.

mukta-m0-p157-v3920.plain_english: He removes darkness, is most excellent, revolves the ages, and creates the beginning of the ages.

mukta-m0-p157-v3921.plain_english: He gives auspiciousness, is auspicious, is splendor, performs auspicious deeds, and is the abode of auspiciousness.

mukta-m0-p157-v3922.plain_english: He bears strength, gives strength, is a kinsman, strong, and the best among the strong.

mukta-m0-p157-v3923.plain_english: He is the leader of the year and sacrifice, and the one who sets the wheel of time in motion.

mukta-m0-p157-v3924.plain_english: He is of beautiful form, good-minded Soma, Govinda, and born at the beginning of the world.

mukta-m0-p157-v3925.plain_english: He is beyond Indra, of manifold form, Skanda, the conqueror of enemy cities.

mukta-m0-p166-v4126.plain_english: He is the root nature and bliss, the knower of wisdom, and the deluder of the universe.

mukta-m0-p166-v4127.plain_english: He is desired by all, of infinite nature, and the one who subdues and benefits all beings.

mukta-m0-p166-v4128.plain_english: He is without conditions, beloved, the swan, perishable, and the controller of all.

mukta-m0-p166-v4129.plain_english: He is the knower of the field, the lord of nature, the spirit, and the holder of the universe's thread.

mukta-m0-p166-v4130.plain_english: He is sought through yoga, lotus-naveled, reclining on Śeṣa, and the lord of Śrī.

mukta-m0-p166-v4131.plain_english: He bears Śrī eternally on his chest, is the treasure of Śrī, the bearer of Śrī, and Hari.

mukta-m0-p166-v4132.plain_english: His chest is illuminated by the Kaustubha gem; he is Mādhava, the destroyer of the world's distress.

mukta-m0-p166-v4133.plain_english: Clad in yellow, he is the lord of the world, the sustainer of the world, and the father of the world.

mukta-m0-p166-v4134.plain_english: His heroism alone shines forth in the world; he does not speak from ego, and he is made of the world.

mukta-m0-p166-v4135.plain_english: All his efforts are unfailing, and his consciousness surpasses that of Brahmā, Rudra, and others.

mukta-m0-p166-v4136.plain_english: He is dear to all gods, the very activity of all gods, and unsurpassed.

mukta-m0-p166-v4137.plain_english: He is the enjoyer of sacrifice, the giver of its fruits, the lord of sacrifice, and the inspirer of sacrifice.

mukta-m0-p166-v4138.plain_english: He alone gives honor to the twice-born, is fierce, the family deity, and the destroyer of demons.

mukta-m0-p166-v4139.plain_english: He is the sole womb of all worlds and the sole sphere of all worlds.

mukta-m0-p166-v4140.plain_english: He bears the conch, holds the Nandaka sword and a lotus in his hands, and has Garuḍa as his vehicle.

mukta-m0-p166-v4141.plain_english: He is of infinite fame, lord without fortune, manly, and entirely auspicious.

mukta-m0-p166-v4142.plain_english: He is the creator of worlds of crores of Brahmās and possesses the great strength of crores of winds.

mukta-m0-p166-v4143.plain_english: He possesses the wealth of crores of Kuberas and is the destroyer of crores of enemies.

mukta-m0-p166-v4144.plain_english: He is as profound as crores of oceans and is named like crores of holy places.

mukta-m0-p166-v4145.plain_english: He destroys sins as if through crores of horse sacrifices, and worship of him equals crores of sacrifices.

mukta-m0-p166-v4146.plain_english: He is the form of crores of knowledges of Brahman, pervading the rays, and of pure fame.

mukta-m0-p166-v4147.plain_english: He is the primeval god, conqueror of the world, Mukunda the giver of liberation, and the slayer of Kālanemi.

mukta-m0-p166-v4148.plain_english: He is eternally content, of true nature among humans, fearless, and the destroyer of hell.

mukta-m0-p166-v4149.plain_english: He brings forbearance to the world, is eternal, compassionate, and the refuge of good people.

mukta-m0-p166-v4150.plain_english: He is beyond the senses, the seed of the universe, and the lord of Prajāpati's meditation.

mukta-m0-p167-v4151.plain_english: He has the sun and moon as eyes, is the eater of the universe, and has gone beyond all.

mukta-m0-p167-v4152.plain_english: He is the lord of all worlds, free from possessiveness, unattached, and endowed with wondrous enjoyment.

mukta-m0-p167-v4153.plain_english: He is all, the lord of the goddess Śrī, and adorned with every ornament.

mukta-m0-p167-v4154.plain_english: He is all-knowing among all the gods and the leader of all deities.

mukta-m0-p167-v4155.plain_english: He is the armor of all the gods and the crest jewel of all the gods.

mukta-m0-p167-v4156.plain_english: He is all-pervading, the benefactor of all, and also the sun; he has slain his enemies and grants excellent delight.

mukta-m0-p167-v4157.plain_english: He is endowed with Brahmā and Śambhu as his halves, elder to Brahmā, yet a child, and self-ruling.

mukta-m0-p167-v4158.plain_english: He accomplishes all purposes, knows what is to be done, and has always abandoned action for his own sake.

mukta-m0-p167-v4159.plain_english: He is always unpleasant, always satisfied, always nourished, and always worshipped.

mukta-m0-p167-v4160.plain_english: He has a thousand names, belongs to three ages, has four forms, and four arms.

mukta-m0-p167-v4161.plain_english: He is Nārāyaṇa, with hair like muñja grass, and emerged beyond all yoga.

mukta-m0-p167-v4162.plain_english: He is the best among the Sādhyas, an ancient seer, devoted to steadfastness and peace.

mukta-m0-p167-v4163.plain_english: He is Nara and Kṛṣṇa, Hari, the son of Dharma, and one who lives by dharma.

mukta-m0-p167-v4164.plain_english: He is beyond time, conqueror of Kandarpa, and the lord of sages seen by Urvaśī.

mukta-m0-p167-v4165.plain_english: He consists of all gods, is the teacher of Brahmā, and the lord of the goddess of speech.

mukta-m0-p167-v4166.plain_english: He is worthy of honor from all, destroyer of the world's dullness, and the slayer of Madhu.

mukta-m0-p167-v4167.plain_english: He is the primeval knower, maker of the Veda, the very self of the Veda, and an ocean of scripture.

mukta-m0-p167-v4168.plain_english: He is the king of knowledge, king of wisdom, an ocean of wisdom, and of unbroken intellect.

mukta-m0-p167-v4169.plain_english: He pervades the wind and ocean in play and is the promulgator of the four Vedas.

mukta-m0-p167-v4170.plain_english: He made the host of gods immortal and is the cause of the origin of nectar.

mukta-m0-p167-v4171.plain_english: He is the slayer of Hiraṇyākṣa, lord of the earth, and ordainer of śrāddha and other rites.

mukta-m0-p167-v4172.plain_english: He is the excellent sole enjoyer of oblations and libations, and the sole giver of excellent virtues.

mukta-m0-p167-v4173.plain_english: He is the great boar, destroyer of those who harm sacrifice, and the refuge of sacrificers.

mukta-m0-p167-v4174.plain_english: He is the one hero of wondrous strength and the sole breaker of yantras and mantras.

mukta-m0-p167-v4175.plain_english: He has nails harder than millions of thunderbolts and bears a form as difficult to behold as a mighty elephant.

mukta-m0-p169-v4201.plain_english: Bhīṣma is a treasury of all Śiva’s knowledge, a great teacher, and one whose deity is fire.

mukta-m0-p169-v4202.plain_english: He is a form of unmatched darkness, whose sole offering is lifelong celibacy.

mukta-m0-p169-v4203.plain_english: He is the primordial king, father of the earth, who makes it yield all jewels.

mukta-m0-p169-v4204.plain_english: He gives sustenance to the world, is the best of emperors, and bears terrible weapons.

mukta-m0-p169-v4205.plain_english: He is the doer, expounder, and promoter of the duties of the classes and stages of life.

mukta-m0-p169-v4206.plain_english: He embodies the heroic duty of the Kakutstha line and bears the burden of royal duty.

mukta-m0-p169-v4207.plain_english: He is the nine jewels, a treasury of gems, the overseer of all, and a great treasure.

mukta-m0-p169-v4208.plain_english: The world-subduing son of Daśaratha is the king, the refuge of all jewels.

mukta-m0-p169-v4209.plain_english: He sees the far shore of knowledge and insight beyond Indra, and he is an ocean of forbearance.

mukta-m0-p169-v4210.plain_english: At his father's command he gave up sovereignty, yet remained fearless of any rival's rise.

mukta-m0-p169-v4211.plain_english: He is the lord of the world who gained the jewel-mountain Citrakūṭa and moves in battle.

mukta-m0-p169-v4212.plain_english: His arrow is revered by Brahmā, Indra, and others; he is the slayer of Mārīca and Virādha.

mukta-m0-p169-v4213.plain_english: He bore a single arrow that slew the fourteen thousand demons.

mukta-m0-p169-v4214.plain_english: He gave Jaṭāyu the path through fire and granted heaven to Kabandha.

mukta-m0-p169-v4215.plain_english: He is the one who, by piercing seven palm trees, drew down the banner of the demon of the netherworld.

mukta-m0-p169-v4216.plain_english: He is the lord of Hanūmat, chief among the Rudras, and the sustainer of all the monkey bodies.

mukta-m0-p169-v4217.plain_english: With a single arrow he dried and burned the ocean, along with countless barbarians.

mukta-m0-p169-v4218.plain_english: He is a treasure of fame for building a wondrous, unprecedented bridge across the ocean.

mukta-m0-p169-v4219.plain_english: He cut down the Paulastya lineage in Janasthāna, made arrogant by boons.

mukta-m0-p169-v4220.plain_english: He cut off Rāvaṇa's head and gave Indra fearless, sole sovereignty.

mukta-m0-p169-v4221.plain_english: He removes the godhood of demons, is a mansion of dharma, and is praised by many.

mukta-m0-p169-v4222.plain_english: He alone revived his entire dead army by creating nectar.

mukta-m0-p169-v4223.plain_english: He is revered by Brahmā, Sūrya, Indra, Rudra, and others, worshipped, and dear to the good.

mukta-m0-p169-v4224.plain_english: Endowed with a lord's unequaled compassion, he is dear to the good, whether low or high.

mukta-m0-p169-v4225.plain_english: Acting as yours in the fitting guise of a hunter, he brings satisfaction to all.

mukta-m0-p170-v4226.plain_english: Directly manifest, skilled, led by noble Indra and Agni, he is unconquered.

mukta-m0-p170-v4227.plain_english: He is the delighter of Yaśodā, joyful, and the rising one over the circle of the earth.

mukta-m0-p170-v4228.plain_english: Having attained the world of Brahma, he is the protector of caṇḍālas and all other beings.

mukta-m0-p170-v4229.plain_english: He is Rāma's companion, Lakṣmaṇa son of Sumitrā, the slayer of Indrajit.

mukta-m0-p170-v4230.plain_english: He is Bharata, slayer of millions of formidable gandharvas, and destroyer of Lavaṇa.

mukta-m0-p170-v4231.plain_english: He is the source of the eternal and non-eternal, Dhanvantari, sacrifice, and the supporter of the world.

mukta-m0-p170-v4232.plain_english: He is the one with severed head, afflicted for the sake of instruction, who made friendship with a son.

mukta-m0-p170-v4233.plain_english: Yoga-natured, upon the breaking of meditation, he reduced the sons of Sagara to ashes.

mukta-m0-p170-v4234.plain_english: He is Śambhu, burner of the three cities, who uplifted the chariot on which the universe was steadied.

mukta-m0-p170-v4235.plain_english: He is the fire named by the Vājapeya and other rites, devoted to the duties of the Veda.

mukta-m0-p170-v4236.plain_english: He is the yoga of meditation that illuminates the universe and removes the darkness of delusion.

mukta-m0-p170-v4237.plain_english: At the great dissolution he is the one, without a second, the king of all demons.

mukta-m0-p170-v4238.plain_english: He is the one by whose serpent-hood form the earth is placed upon the waters.

mukta-m0-p170-v4239.plain_english: Clad in blue, lord of Vāruṇī, he removes the faults of mind, speech, and body.

mukta-m0-p170-v4240.plain_english: He is the restrainer of Bali, terrible, the son of Rohiṇī, the slayer of Pralamba.

mukta-m0-p170-v4241.plain_english: He is the lover of Revatī, indeed of ancient devotion, the elder brother of Acyuta.

mukta-m0-p170-v4242.plain_english: He is a descendant of Vṛṣṇi, best of the Sātvatas, descendant of Śūra, and upholder of the Yadu family.

mukta-m0-p170-v4243.plain_english: His childhood, desired by Brahmā and others, is an eternal festival for the world.

mukta-m0-p170-v4244.plain_english: He is the enemy of the demon Vatsa, slayer of Keśin, enemy of Dhenuka, and lord of cows.

mukta-m0-p170-v4245.plain_english: He is the subduer of Kāliya, beloved by all the cowherds and cowherdesses.

mukta-m0-p170-v4246.plain_english: He is the crusher of Ariṣṭa and the giver of liberation to the cowherdesses maddened by love.

mukta-m0-p170-v4247.plain_english: He is the enemy of Kaṃsa, who established Ugrasena and others in the kingdom, destroyer of enemies, immortal.

mukta-m0-p170-v4248.plain_english: He abandoned his devotee Jarāsandha and gave fame to Bhīmasena.

mukta-m0-p170-v4249.plain_english: He is the lover of Rukmiṇī, the chastiser of Rukmin, and the destroyer of Naraka.

mukta-m0-p170-v4250.plain_english: Beloved of all beautiful women, enemy of the demons, he is the one whose banner bears Garuḍa.

mukta-m0-p172-v4276.plain_english: The lord of stars, radiant like the sun, is the best; Venus is the lord of poets.

mukta-m0-p172-v4277.plain_english: Wind and pure fire are the best; Shankara is the king of the Rudras and the teacher.

mukta-m0-p172-v4278.plain_english: The first of letters is foremost, Gauri is the foremost woman, Shri is the foremost power, and Narada is foremost.

mukta-m0-p172-v4279.plain_english: Pavana is the lord of the winds, and Varuna is the lord of aquatic creatures.

mukta-m0-p172-v4280.plain_english: Food is foremost; the Sudarshana is the foremost weapon, and the thunderbolt is the best striking weapon.

mukta-m0-p172-v4281.plain_english: Arundhati is foremost, the lord devoted to one wife is supreme, and indeed the sacred fig tree is the king of all trees.

mukta-m0-p172-v4282.plain_english: Meru is the lord of mountains, the path is foremost, the Sama is the foremost chant, and it is the best of times.

mukta-m0-p172-v4283.plain_english: Tarkshya is the king of birds, the foremost priest, spring is the foremost season, and the wish-fulfilling tree is foremost.

mukta-m0-p172-v4284.plain_english: The wish-fulfilling jewel is foremost, the best teacher is foremost, the mother is most beneficial, and the father is foremost.

mukta-m0-p172-v4285.plain_english: The lord of letters, the brahmin, and the foremost inner organ are supreme; obeisance, obeisance.

mukta-m0-p172-v4286.plain_english: It pacifies all offenses and increases supreme devotion.

mukta-m0-p172-v4287.plain_english: It is the sole stairway to the world of Vishnu and the destroyer of all sorrows.

mukta-m0-p172-v4288.plain_english: It completely removes desire, anger, and the rest, and purifies all faults and impurities.

mukta-m0-p172-v4289.plain_english: It quickly grants all desired fruits to all living beings.

mukta-m0-p172-v4290.plain_english: It pacifies terrible sorrow and destroys intense poverty.

mukta-m0-p172-v4291.plain_english: It grants all sovereignty, all accomplishments, and benefits at all times.

mukta-m0-p172-v4292.plain_english: It pacifies ignorance and dullness and promotes all knowledge.

mukta-m0-p172-v4293.plain_english: It quickly grants sons to barren women and gives all the best fruits.

mukta-m0-p172-v4294.plain_english: It is auspicious, meritorious, and life-promoting through hearing, recitation, and repetition.

mukta-m0-p172-v4295.plain_english: Puranas, scriptures, and Smritis have been recited and likewise taught to others.

mukta-m0-p172-v4296.plain_english: It always succeeds quickly for everyone; how much more so does it succeed entirely.

mukta-m0-p172-v4297.plain_english: O auspicious one, this must be kept secret by you and recited for the attainment of your own purpose.

mukta-m0-p172-v4298.plain_english: It must not be given to one devoid of devotion and faith, or to one who sees Vishnu as ordinary.

mukta-m0-p172-v4299.plain_english: Without my grace, those of little intelligence will not grasp this.

mukta-m0-p172-v4300.plain_english: By which the sorrow of people devoid of fortune will be destroyed.

mukta-m0-p30-v726.plain_english: She is attached to the multitude of stellar qualities and is the abode of the multitude of stellar qualities.

mukta-m0-p30-v727.plain_english: She is the chief of stars, indeed named Tārā, skilled, and indeed the savior.
mukta-m0-p30-v727.sanskrit_cite: tāramukhyā tu tārākhyā tāradakṣā tu tāriṇī

mukta-m0-p30-v728.plain_english: She is auspicious, indeed the syllable Tārā, recipient of oblations, and indeed the savior.
mukta-m0-p30-v728.sanskrit_cite: tārabhavyā tu tārārṇā tārahavyā tu tāriṇī

mukta-m0-p30-v729.plain_english: She is endowed with the splendor of a garland of stars, and her courtyard is surrounded by stars.

mukta-m0-p30-v730.plain_english: Her limbs shine with star-bracelets, and she wears bangles adorned with stars.

mukta-m0-p30-v731.plain_english: She wears garments patterned with stars and has a seat-circle of stars.

mukta-m0-p30-v732.plain_english: She is resplendent in her cheeks with a pair of earrings filled with stars.

mukta-m0-p30-v733.plain_english: Her heart is given to the stars, and her arrows are adorned with stars.

mukta-m0-p30-v734.plain_english: She is pleased by Tāraka-nyāsa and grants success through Tāraka-nyāsa.

mukta-m0-p30-v735.plain_english: She is delighted by Tāraka-nyāsa and grants success through Tāraka-nyāsa.

mukta-m0-p30-v736.plain_english: She brings about complete mantra-success through Tāraka-nyāsa.

mukta-m0-p30-v737.plain_english: She is attainable by the worshippers of Tāraka and grants their desires.

mukta-m0-p30-v738.plain_english: She is worshipped by the worshippers of Tāraka and is their refuge.

mukta-m0-p30-v739.plain_english: She is the maker of the demon Tāraka's creation and is saluted by the demon Tāraka.

mukta-m0-p30-v740.plain_english: She is accomplished in relation to the demon Tāraka and is the deity of the demon Tāraka.

mukta-m0-p30-v741.plain_english: She is connected with the demon Tāraka and gives pride to the demon Tāraka.

mukta-m0-p30-v742.plain_english: She is the dancer in the battle of the demon Tāraka and the destroyer of Tāraka.

mukta-m0-p30-v743.plain_english: She is saluted by the multitude of corpses in the battle of the demon Tāraka.

mukta-m0-p30-v744.plain_english: She instructs the mind-captivating garments and ornaments of the enemy of Tāraka.

mukta-m0-p30-v745.plain_english: She is pleased by the speech of the enemy of Tāraka and is well taught by him.

mukta-m0-p30-v746.plain_english: She is placed on the lap of the enemy of Tāraka and gives joy to the enemy of Tāraka.

mukta-m0-p30-v747.plain_english: She is attached to places pervaded by darkness and resembles a veil of darkness.

mukta-m0-p30-v748.plain_english: She is darkness-bodied, giver of darkness, vessel of darkness, and remover of darkness.

mukta-m0-p30-v749.plain_english: She is the destroyer of the mass of darkness and terrifying to the mass of darkness.

mukta-m0-p30-v750.plain_english: She abides in the path declared by the quality of darkness and shines with the quality of darkness.

mukta-m0-p35-v851.plain_english: She gives pain, she causes pain, and she destroys pain.

mukta-m0-p35-v852.plain_english: She terrifies, she is free from fear, and she uproots fear completely.

mukta-m0-p35-v853.plain_english: She delights in singing melodies, creates melodies, and sings melodies.

mukta-m0-p35-v854.plain_english: She is satisfied and fully satiated by the nectar of youth.

mukta-m0-p35-v855.plain_english: She is endowed with the qualities of youth and skilled in youthful speech.

mukta-m0-p35-v856.plain_english: Her mouth is filled with betel, and her lips are reddened by betel.

mukta-m0-p35-v857.plain_english: She is set amid jeweled ear ornaments and adorned with a pair of them.

mukta-m0-p35-v858.plain_english: Dwelling on the third lunar day she is worshipped, and she grants boons to the lords of lunar days.

mukta-m0-p35-v859.plain_english: She is most excellent, resembles sesame, and is worshipped and honored with sesame.

mukta-m0-p35-v860.plain_english: She gives fruit, resembles sesame, and produces sesame oil.

mukta-m0-p35-v861.plain_english: She is pleased by oblations of sesame and ghee, and she grants success through them.

mukta-m0-p35-v862.plain_english: She is supreme in receiving sesame-flower offerings and destroys the mere likeness of sesame flowers.

mukta-m0-p35-v863.plain_english: Her forehead mark is drawn with musk, and its fragrance enchants all.

mukta-m0-p35-v864.plain_english: She is renowned as the form of the three qualities, and she is the three forms whose essence is the three qualities.

mukta-m0-p35-v865.plain_english: She is the goddess of Tripura, dwells in the three worlds, is Tripurī, and is the mother of Tripura.

mukta-m0-p35-v866.plain_english: She is the ornament on the head of Tripura's enemy and grants boons to him.

mukta-m0-p35-v867.plain_english: She forms half the body of Tripura's enemy and sports delightfully with him.

mukta-m0-p35-v868.plain_english: She is well worshipped by the demons of Tripura and is supreme among them.

mukta-m0-p35-v869.plain_english: She stands in the middle of Mount Trikuta and dwells there.

mukta-m0-p35-v870.plain_english: She is three-braided, the goddess of Trijata, and the giver of boons to Trijata.

mukta-m0-p35-v871.plain_english: She has the three folds, is endowed with them, and holds an excellent trident.

mukta-m0-p35-v872.plain_english: She is the three mantras, is worshipped through the three mantras, and is the goddess of their worshippers.

mukta-m0-p35-v873.plain_english: She is pleased by worship with the three mantras and grants liberation through meditation on them.

mukta-m0-p35-v874.plain_english: She abides in the three states, is their goddess, and is completely filled with them.

mukta-m0-p35-v875.plain_english: She is pleased by the sipping of the three principles and grants the desired fruit of that three-principle sipping.

mukta-m0-p36-v876.plain_english: She dwells in the middle of the triangle-circle and has the form of the point within the triangle.

mukta-m0-p36-v877.plain_english: She is fully worshipped in the triangle diagram and grants accomplishment through it.

mukta-m0-p36-v878.plain_english: She abides in three syllables, is endowed with them, and grants boons through them.

mukta-m0-p36-v879.plain_english: She is endowed with the three aims of life, is their mistress, and grants their fruits and more.

mukta-m0-p36-v880.plain_english: She is pleased by worship at the three twilights and grants liberation through recitation at those times.

mukta-m0-p36-v881.plain_english: She is mistress of what is taught by three words, is herself three-worded, and is the expounder.

mukta-m0-p36-v882.plain_english: She is beloved and desired in relation to the three powers and is surrounded by them.

mukta-m0-p36-v883.plain_english: She is pleased by the water of the three streams and grants merit to those who bathe there.

mukta-m0-p36-v884.plain_english: Her body is purified by the water of the three streams, and she is worshipped with that water.

mukta-m0-p36-v885.plain_english: She is auspicious at the junction of the three channels, is associated with the three channels, and is linked with three crores.

mukta-m0-p36-v886.plain_english: She abides on the three paths, is mistress of the three worlds, and grants liberation to three crores of families.

mukta-m0-p36-v887.plain_english: The thirty gods take shelter at her lotus feet, and she moves about in their abode.

mukta-m0-p36-v888.plain_english: She is endowed with the sovereignty of the thirty gods and is served by their lord.

mukta-m0-p36-v889.plain_english: Her moonlight surpasses that of the moon, and her face surpasses the moon's beauty.

mukta-m0-p36-v890.plain_english: Her face has beauty surpassing the moon and is adorned with crores of gems.

mukta-m0-p36-v891.plain_english: She is mistress of the three times, is worshipped at all three times, and grants knowledge of past, present, and future.

mukta-m0-p36-v892.plain_english: She was born in the land of Tirabhukti and dwells there.

mukta-m0-p36-v893.plain_english: Her body shines like crores of sharp rays, and her form is like crores of sharp rays.

mukta-m0-p36-v894.plain_english: She holds shining sharp scissors in one hand and bears a sharp sword.

mukta-m0-p36-v895.plain_english: She is adorned with eight fierce serpents and decorated with fierce skulls.

mukta-m0-p36-v896.plain_english: She is mistress of the foremost holy place, grants the fruit of holy places, and gives the merit of gifts made there.

mukta-m0-p36-v897.plain_english: She is delighted by tumultuous blood and dwells in a tumultuous courtyard.

mukta-m0-p36-v898.plain_english: She delights in the movement of horses and moves with the speed of a horse.

mukta-m0-p36-v899.plain_english: She is mistress of balance, is associated with the sign Libra, and knows the subtle.

mukta-m0-p36-v900.plain_english: She is Tulasī, the excellent Tulasī, the one born of balance, and the sovereign lady of those born of balance.

mukta-m0-p47-v1151.plain_english: She is the lady of emotion, attainable through emotion, abiding in emotion, and proud of emotion.

mukta-m0-p47-v1152.plain_english: She is Bhagirathi, fortunate, and the art that brings about the rise of fortune.

mukta-m0-p47-v1153.plain_english: She moves in fortune, is the essence of fortune, the stream of fortune, and the giver of fortune.

mukta-m0-p47-v1154.plain_english: She is the sight of fortune, the leader of fortune, the giver of the fortune of fortunes, and the mother of fortune.

mukta-m0-p47-v1155.plain_english: She is the lady of brothers, having brothers, the mother of brothers, and the protector of brothers.

mukta-m0-p47-v1156.plain_english: She takes the form of a Bhilla, is accompanied by Bhillas, abides among Bhillas, and protects the Bhillas.

mukta-m0-p47-v1157.plain_english: She is the fame of the Bhillas, the art of the Bhillas, and the one who dwells in the Mandara of the Bhillas.

mukta-m0-p47-v1158.plain_english: She is the daughter-in-law of a Bhilla, the daughter of a Bhilla, the leader of the Bhillas, and the nourisher of the Bhillas.

mukta-m0-p47-v1159.plain_english: She is worshipped by the Bhillas, the speech of the Bhillas, the leader of the Bhillas, and the remover of the Bhillas' fear.

mukta-m0-p47-v1160.plain_english: She gives fear, removes fear, acts through fear, and sports in the form of fear.

mukta-m0-p47-v1161.plain_english: She acts by the manner of fear, is the art of fear, the sight of fear, and the remover of fear.

mukta-m0-p47-v1162.plain_english: She is the lady of the terrible, delighting in the terrible, terrible-limbed, and protector of the terrible.

mukta-m0-p47-v1163.plain_english: She is the terrible assembly, the supporter of the terrible, and the one who delights in terrible knowledge.

mukta-m0-p47-v1164.plain_english: She is the goddess who causes terrible bliss and who sports in terrible bliss.

mukta-m0-p47-v1165.plain_english: She is terrible accomplishment, terrible prosperity, and the increaser of terrible devotion.

mukta-m0-p47-v1166.plain_english: She is the lady of Bhishma, the nourisher of Bhishma, and the awakener of Bhishma's awareness.

mukta-m0-p47-v1167.plain_english: She abides in Bhishma, is present through Bhishma's austerity, is the lady of Bhishma, and the savior of Bhishma.

mukta-m0-p47-v1168.plain_english: She is the refuge of Bhishma, the boon of Bhishma, and the increaser of Bhishma's joy.

mukta-m0-p47-v1169.plain_english: She abides on the earth, is the form of the earth, and removes the burden of the earth.

mukta-m0-p47-v1170.plain_english: She is the lady of enjoyment, the giver of enjoyment, and the one whose form is the nature of enjoyment.

mukta-m0-p47-v1171.plain_english: She is the serpent-woman, the abode of serpents, and the giver of joy to serpents.

mukta-m0-p47-v1172.plain_english: She is the lady of beings, the play of beings, and always the one who assumes the forms of beings.

mukta-m0-p47-v1173.plain_english: She acts by the manner of beings, is the consort of Bhuta, and dwells in the world of beings.

mukta-m0-p47-v1174.plain_english: She is the fame of beings, the fortune of beings, and the increaser of the fortune of beings.

mukta-m0-p47-v1175.plain_english: She is the granddaughter of beings, the daughter of beings, and the sovereign lady of the lord of the consort of beings.

mukta-m0-p49-v1201.plain_english: She fashions the refuge of Bhairava and is delighted in the refuge of Bhairava.

mukta-m0-p49-v1202.plain_english: She is the ascertainment of the refuge of Bhairava and the one who sustains it.

mukta-m0-p49-v1203.plain_english: She abides in the blissful awareness of Bhairava and grants that blissful awareness.

mukta-m0-p49-v1204.plain_english: She fashions the sovereignty of Bhairavi and increases it.

mukta-m0-p49-v1205.plain_english: She is the mistress of the accomplishment of Bhairavi's sovereignty and has the form of that sovereignty.

mukta-m0-p49-v1206.plain_english: She abides in the growth of Bhairavi's sovereignty and grants its growth.

mukta-m0-p49-v1207.plain_english: She makes the sovereignty of Bhairavi easily attainable and bestows it.

mukta-m0-p49-v1208.plain_english: She embodies humility regarding Bhairavi's sovereignty and is the knower of that sovereignty.

mukta-m0-p49-v1209.plain_english: She delights in the sovereignty of Bhairavi and is fashioned as that sovereignty.

mukta-m0-p49-v1210.plain_english: She is the sport and play of enjoyment, the mistress of enjoyment, and the one who increases enjoyment.

mukta-m0-p49-v1211.plain_english: She is the refuge of enjoyment, possessed of enjoyment, the enjoyer, and having the form of enjoyment.

mukta-m0-p49-v1212.plain_english: She is the mother of enjoyment, delights in enjoyment, and bestows the accomplishment of enjoyment.

mukta-m0-p49-v1213.plain_english: She is a wave of bliss in food and sports within food.

mukta-m0-p49-v1214.plain_english: She fashions the bliss of food and is delighted by the bliss of food.

mukta-m0-p49-v1215.plain_english: She practices the conduct of food and is worshipped through the conduct of food.

mukta-m0-p49-v1216.plain_english: She abides in the mind devoted to the conduct of food and gives the methods of that conduct.

mukta-m0-p49-v1217.plain_english: She delights in the conduct of food and protects that conduct.

mukta-m0-p49-v1218.plain_english: She gives happiness through the conduct of food and holds auspicious desire for that conduct.

mukta-m0-p49-v1219.plain_english: She practices the taking of food and nourishment and is restless in relation to it.

mukta-m0-p49-v1220.plain_english: She is satisfied by the taste of food and bestows that taste.

mukta-m0-p49-v1221.plain_english: She delights in the taste of food and is ascertained in that taste.

mukta-m0-p49-v1222.plain_english: She abides in the syllable bhau and dwells in the abode that originates from the syllable bhau.

mukta-m0-p49-v1223.plain_english: She is the sound bha, the breaker, ash itself, abiding in ash and dwelling in ash.

mukta-m0-p49-v1224.plain_english: She is rich in the syllable bha, mistress of the syllable bha, having the form of bha, and having a radiant form.

mukta-m0-p49-v1225.plain_english: She delights in the bliss of the earth-holder and protects the bliss of the earth-holder.

mukta-m0-p57-v1401.plain_english: She consists of the womb-wheel, she is the womb, and she sets the womb-wheel in motion.

mukta-m0-p57-v1402.plain_english: She has the form of the diagram, consists of the diagram, is the lady of the diagram, and is worshipped in the diagram.

mukta-m0-p57-v1403.plain_english: She is reddish, red-eyed, and devoted to drinking blood.

mukta-m0-p57-v1404.plain_english: She is engaged in Bhairava practice and is served by Bhūtabhairava.

mukta-m0-p57-v1405.plain_english: She is worshipped and praised by Bhava, and she carries beings across the ocean of existence.

mukta-m0-p57-v1406.plain_english: She is of auspicious form, greatly auspicious, very auspicious, and the protector of auspiciousness.

mukta-m0-p57-v1407.plain_english: She gives accomplishment, is a multitude of accomplishments, is accomplished, and is served by the accomplished.

mukta-m0-p57-v1408.plain_english: The goddess consists of the supreme vision and causes the dissolution of limited views.

mukta-m0-p57-v1409.plain_english: She is auspicious, peaceful, of the form of peace, Mṛḍānī, and afflicted by love.

mukta-m0-p57-v1410.plain_english: More secret than secret, to be hidden and concealed with effort.

mukta-m0-p57-v1411.plain_english: O goddess, killing, deluding, and indeed expelling are the supreme matters thereafter.

mukta-m0-p57-v1412.plain_english: From reciting this at the three times, all things are accomplished, without doubt.

mukta-m0-p57-v1413.plain_english: Those best among men who recite this with devotion will not suffer defeat by enemies.
mukta-m0-p57-v1413.sanskrit_cite: paṭhanti ye bhaktiyutā narottamā bhavenna teṣāṃ ripubhiḥ parājayaḥ

mukta-m0-p57-v1414.plain_english: We praise you in your gross form, the mother of all speech.

mukta-m0-p57-v1415.plain_english: O Tripurā, we worship you, shining with the burden of garlands.

mukta-m0-p57-v1417.plain_english: We consider you to be a boundless ocean of compassion.

mukta-m0-p57-v1418.plain_english: Holding explanation in her lotus hands, and three-eyed.

mukta-m0-p57-v1419.plain_english: I never forget in my heart your form, which consists of consciousness.

mukta-m0-p57-v1420.plain_english: O mother, your form is the friend of the young sun for the virtuous.

mukta-m0-p57-v1421.plain_english: It is true, O daughter of the mountain, sole mother of the world: if not for you, the existence of the entire world would not be.
mukta-m0-p57-v1421.sanskrit_cite: satyantadadritanaye jagadekamātarno cedaśeṣajagataḥ sthitireva na syāt

mukta-m0-p57-v1422.plain_english: Her limbs sprinkled with supreme nectar...

mukta-m0-p57-v1423.plain_english: O Tripurā, properly understood as the abode where good fortune is born...

mukta-m0-p57-v1424.plain_english: I never forget that Śāradā in my mind.

mukta-m0-p57-v1425.plain_english: The wise ones call you, O daughter of the mountain-king.

mukta-m0-p82-v2026.plain_english: She is victorious, the giver of victory, eternal, and her splendor is like blazing fire.

mukta-m0-p82-v2027.plain_english: She is prosperous, she is the submarine fire, and she grants the fruits of fire oblations.

mukta-m0-p82-v2028.plain_english: She is Gaya, Ganga, Gomati, Prabhasa, and also Pushkara.
mukta-m0-p82-v2028.sanskrit_cite: gayā gaṅgā gomatī ca prabhāsā puṣkarāpi ca

mukta-m0-p82-v2029.plain_english: She is many-formed, very beautiful, and the destroyer of the demon Kamsa.

mukta-m0-p82-v2030.plain_english: She is Durga, auspicious, the maker of peace, Brahmani, and dear to brahmins.

mukta-m0-p82-v2031.plain_english: She is auspicious, beautiful, pure, partless, supreme, and the supreme digit.
mukta-m0-p82-v2031.sanskrit_cite: maṅgalā śobhanā śuddhā niṣkalā paramā kalā

mukta-m0-p82-v2032.plain_english: She is ever-auspicious, Uma, the giver of welfare, Candika, and of fierce valor.

mukta-m0-p82-v2033.plain_english: She is bowed to by Brahma, Shiva, and Vishnu, and she brings about all auspiciousness.

mukta-m0-p82-v2034.plain_english: She is the wife of a yogi, possessed of yoga, and the yogini who brings bliss to the lords of yogis.

mukta-m0-p82-v2035.plain_english: She gives purity, removes fear, and is terrifying to those who hate her devotees.

mukta-m0-p82-v2036.plain_english: She has a form dear to Balabhadra and she rescues beings from the ocean of worldly existence.

mukta-m0-p82-v2037.plain_english: She rides a lion, is the great delusion, and destroys the noose of delusion.

mukta-m0-p82-v2038.plain_english: She is Savitri, the great goddess, and the leader of the supreme beloved.

mukta-m0-p82-v2039.plain_english: She is dear to the moon, delights in the moon, and dwells in a sandalwood forest.

mukta-m0-p82-v2040.plain_english: She is the sovereign of all, a yakshini, Kirati, and likewise a rakshasi.
mukta-m0-p82-v2040.sanskrit_cite: sarveśvarī yakṣiṇī ca kirātī rākṣasī tathā

mukta-m0-p82-v2041.plain_english: She is the destroyer of the universe, whose form is the universe, and who causes the universe's destruction.

mukta-m0-p82-v2042.plain_english: She is Kamala, the giver of subtlety, the goddess, the supporter, and the destroyer of Hara.

mukta-m0-p82-v2043.plain_english: She is the goddess possessing the supreme form, who causes the attraction of the three worlds.

mukta-m0-p82-v2044.plain_english: O beloved, whether one recites or causes others to recite, all success may be attained.

mukta-m0-p82-v2045.plain_english: O Parvati, in the morning, at midday, and at twilight.
mukta-m0-p82-v2045.sanskrit_cite: prātaḥ kāle ca madhyāhne sandhyākāle ca pārvati

mukta-m0-p82-v2046.plain_english: Whoever recites it even once, for that person there will be the destruction of all sins.

mukta-m0-p82-v2047.plain_english: O goddess, from reciting it three times, everything succeeds in every way.

mukta-m0-p82-v2048.plain_english: The seeker of liberation obtains liberation, and the seeker of wealth obtains wealth.

mukta-m0-p82-v2049.plain_english: Greatness and the destruction of enemies arise by the end of a year.

mukta-m0-p82-v2050.plain_english: O beloved, for one who always recites with devotion, welfare indeed arises.
mukta-m0-p82-v2050.sanskrit_cite: yaḥ paṭhetsarvadā bhaktyā śreyastu bhavati priye

essence: The speaker worships the auspicious goddess who is the mother of auspiciousness.
The speaker worships Lakṣmī as Rohiṇī, who possesses infinite power.
The speaker worships Kālikā, who grants desires and is generous in compassion.
The speaker always worships the goddess Caṇḍikā, who possesses fierce valor.
The speaker worships Śāmbhavī Lakṣmī, who is the soul of all beings.

essence: These names attribute universal creative power, invincibility, and triumphant mastery to Gaṇeśa.
These names present Gaṇeśa as a yogic sovereign and supreme person with distinctive form.
These names align Gaṇeśa with Śiva's radiance, sacrificial embodiment, and universal presence.
The verse highlights distinctive bodily characteristics of Gaṇeśa's form.
Gaṇeśa's form is presented as perfectly complete and fully auspicious.

essence: The supreme being encompasses multiple deities and elemental cosmic forces.
The supreme being is both the radiant source of illumination and the ultimate ground of all praise.
The supreme being embodies healing, well-being, auspiciousness, and supreme capability.
The supreme being unites creative vitality, health, wisdom, kinship, and greatness.
The supreme being combines universal benevolence and endurance with the power to ward off all hostility.
mukta-m0-p157.essence_source: derived from argmap inferences (machine-proposed; assessor review outstanding)

essence: This deity embodies primordial nature, blissful wisdom, and cosmic enchantment.
This deity is universally desirable, boundless, and sovereignly benevolent toward all beings.
This deity transcends conditions while encompassing paradoxical aspects and universal governance.
This deity unites the roles of conscious witness, master of nature, and cosmic sustainer.
These attributes identify the deity with the classical iconography and lordship of Viṣṇu.
mukta-m0-p166.essence_source: derived from argmap inferences (machine-proposed; assessor review outstanding)

essence: The supreme being encompasses cosmic perception, universal consumption, and complete transcendence.
Supreme lordship is compatible with complete detachment and marvelous enjoyment.
The supreme being is all-encompassing, consort of the goddess, and fully adorned.
Supreme knowledge and leadership place the being above all deities.
The being both protects and crowns the entire divine assembly.

essence: Bhīṣma embodies supreme Śaiva knowledge, pedagogical authority, and fiery divinity.
Bhīṣma is characterized by formidable presence and unwavering commitment to celibacy.
The primordial king is a paternal ruler who makes the earth abundantly bountiful.
The supreme emperor combines world-nourishing rule with fearsome martial power.
The ruler enacts, teaches, and establishes the duties of social and religious order.

essence: The unconquered figure appears directly with skill under the leadership of Indra and Agni
Yaśodā's joyful delighter is identified as a rising presence over the earth
The attainer of Brahma's world serves as protector for caṇḍālas and all other beings
Lakṣmaṇa, Rāma's companion and son of Sumitrā, is the slayer of Indrajit
Bharata is characterized by slaying vast numbers of gandharvas and destroying Lavaṇa

essence: The moon-lord and Venus are presented as supreme exemplars in their spheres.
Elemental forces and Shiva are identified as supreme in purity, rulership, and guidance.
Primordial sound, Gauri, Shri, and Narada are presented as supreme in their respective domains.
Pavana and Varuna hold supreme lordship over wind and water creatures respectively.
Food, Sudarshana, and the thunderbolt are identified as supreme in their respective domains.

essence: She is both intimately connected with and the dwelling place of stellar qualities.
The goddess embodies stellar supremacy and the power to save.
Tārā unites auspicious presence, mantra-form, ritual worship, and salvation.
Both her person and dwelling are depicted as radiant with stars.
Her bodily adornment is consistently described as stellar.
mukta-m0-p30.essence_source: derived from argmap inferences (machine-proposed; assessor review outstanding)

essence: The goddess holds sovereign power over both the arising and the removal of suffering.
The goddess transcends fear while wielding and eliminating it.
The goddess embodies the creation, performance, and enjoyment of melody.
The nectar of youth fully satisfies and nourishes the goddess.
The goddess perfectly embodies both the qualities and eloquence of youth.
mukta-m0-p35.essence_source: derived from argmap inferences (machine-proposed; assessor review outstanding)

essence: Her presence is localized and iconically identified at the central point of the triangular diagram.
Worship directed to the triangle diagram both honors her and yields spiritual accomplishment.
Her presence, richness, and boon-giving power are all expressed through three syllables.
She possesses, governs, and dispenses the results of the three aims of life.
Regular twilight worship pleases her and twilight recitation leads to liberation.
mukta-m0-p36.essence_source: derived from argmap inferences (machine-proposed; assessor review outstanding)

essence: Emotion is both her domain and the means by which she is approached and experienced.
She embodies sacred auspiciousness and actively brings fortune into manifestation.
Fortune is fully encompassed in her as its activity, substance, continuity, and gift.
She governs fortune from its perception and direction to its highest bestowal and origin.
She encompasses all relational roles that sustain and govern the sphere of brothers.
mukta-m0-p47.essence_source: derived from argmap inferences (machine-proposed; assessor review outstanding)

essence: The Goddess both creates and joyfully abides in the refuge of Bhairava.
The Goddess both defines and upholds the refuge of Bhairava.
The Goddess both dwells in and bestows the blissful awareness of Bhairava.
The Goddess both creates and augments the sovereignty of Bhairavi.
The Goddess rules over and embodies the sovereignty of Bhairavi.

essence: The goddess embodies, is, and dynamically sets in motion the sacred womb-wheel.
The goddess fully pervades the ritual diagram as its form, substance, ruler, and object of worship.
The goddess is portrayed with fierce red attributes linked to a blood-drinking ritual aspect.
The goddess participates in Bhairava conduct and is attended by Bhairava in his form as lord of beings.
Honored even by Bhava, the goddess delivers beings across the ocean of worldly existence.

essence: The goddess embodies eternal victory and radiant fiery brilliance.
The goddess unites cosmic fiery power with the bestowal of ritual rewards.
The goddess is present as multiple sacred rivers and pilgrimage sites.
The goddess combines manifold beauty with the power to destroy demonic forces.
The goddess is a protective, peace-giving, and revered divine presence.
